_comment: Mutation testing (ADR-0029): run nightly by .github/workflows/mutation.yml; locally `pnpm --filter @tran/core mutation`. A surviving mutant is a missing test. Baseline 97.7% (Oct 2026); the survivors are equivalent mutants behind the `client.unexpected` fallback. Raise `break` with the baseline; never lower it. `inPlace`: the tests read `fixtures/` relative to the repo, which a sandbox copy would break; Stryker restores the sources when it exits.
